title: Fallbunny
wikitext:
Server side setting that disables [[broken ankle]] behavior added to QuakeWorld by the [[Kombat Teams]] mod. It thus allows you to carry on bunny-hopping even after falling from heights causing a "hurt sound" rather than a "thud".

'''Fallbunny''' is turned off by default, but recently it's been getting more acceptance.

Trivia: "fallbunny" is actually what the original Quake mod acts like, the broken ankle was only first introduced with Kombat Teams.
